body:
23 year old male experienced with quite a few substances such as LSD, Psilocybin Mushrooms, MDMA, Cocaine, Ketamine, Cannabis, Hash, Opium, Salvia
I am usually turned off by mushrooms I prefer LSD generally. I ate an 1/8 they were dubbed 'late bloomers' by A and myself. They came on gently slowly and built then leveled off. They were nice for probably two to two and a half hours. I smoked marijuana it was cannabis sativa I felt it would only compliment the trip nothing changed dramatically . During this time we walked around the sky looked beautiful light pastel purple into green it looked like it was the northern lights it was a wonderful evening a very warm spring night. I wasnt experiencing any swirls or patterning, and oddly no paranoia or anxiety. These were things I was expecting with mushrooms I have experienced bad trips with mushrooms in the past. It always included crippling anxiety and paranoia to the point of tears. I thought they were pretty weak at this point I felt at this point Id been lied to. I walked upstairs, back downstairs and thought, well I'm disappointed I'm going to bed if I was to rate how I felt on a scale one 1 to 10 we were both barely visual honestly like a 2 or 3. So little I felt it wouldn't be difficult to sleep I had a lot of mental stimulation, mostly an analysis of my consciousness. For a time reference and some foreshadowing this was about 3:15am we had consumed them at around midnight. I had finally comedown enough to sleep at about 7:30am. These didn't taste like normal mushrooms although these were especially awful they lacked that shit taste  They were bitter, sour, gritty, dirty, and really mushroomy that umami flavor. We decided to head upstairs about the time it took us to walk to our room we quickly climbed from a 2 to a 7 or 8. This was by far the hardest I've tripped on mushrooms; I felt like I had ingested 3 or 4 hits of LSD I personally feel that LSD is more intense than mushrooms, my lady feels the opposite.   Things were crawling the color distortion was like I'd never seen before. Everything wasn't bright or colorful no pearl like appearance on surfaces, everything was intensely golden brownish, think a little darker than 300 the movie. Tans, browns, reds, were all really intense and tinted. I saw my entire life unfold with my eyes shut, I sometimes couldn't tell if my eyes where open or shut. It was extremely intense for a total of around two hours. Intense color distortion, crawling, green and blue geometric imagery with my eyes shut ovals sideways mirrored next to each other full of green and blue crystals without borders. These resembled eyes and oddly enough my eye color is a mixture of blue and green. These ovals full of crystals appeared to be full of energy. I had been chewing gum all night earlier on our walk we stopped into a store to buy cigarettes and something to drink the cashier sarcastically commented about how loud I was chewing my gum I felt a little like I was grinding my teeth. I opened my eyes and looked in the mirror I was chewing my gum so loud and intensely due to the level of intensity of the trip I believe; it was so loud I could hear it over the mental noise. I cant remember a lot after that, I remember feeling a lot of insight to life careers and the future. Thinking of ways to be successful, facing problems I didnt want to see. These were things I was thinking about I am pretty sure I had my eyes shut at this point. I fell into an introspective trance I felt like I had fallen asleep almost, I feel this is probably because I laid in bed motionless with my eyes shut. I slowly came down giggling and grinning. It was a glowing spiritual experience an experience I thought Id never experience again due to my complicated past with psilocybin.
